title: Junior Data Analyst Intern
description_text:
Start your career in data analytics and business reporting with CareStack as a Junior Data Analyst Intern in Bhilwara. You will sit with a working team, use the same tools and systems they do, and own a defined piece of work from day one.

About the role
As a Junior Data Analyst Intern at CareStack, your core focus will be supporting senior analysts on recurring reports, data validation and first-pass analysis. You are attached to a named mentor, join the team's stand-ups and reviews, and are trusted with work that matters rather than filler tasks. Questions are encouraged, your output is reviewed properly, and you get the feedback you need to actually improve.

What you'll do day to day
• Work on supporting senior analysts on recurring reports, data validation and first-pass analysis alongside the core team
• Use SQL, Microsoft Excel, Power BI, Python (Pandas), Data Cleaning & Wrangling on live, production-facing problems
• Turn your work into clear documentation, notes or decks for reviewers
• Take part in reviews and act on the feedback you receive
• Collaborate across functions — engineering, product, design or business as the work demands
• Follow the team's quality, testing and documentation standards
• Track and report your own progress against an agreed plan

Skills you'll build
You will build practical, demonstrable experience in SQL, Microsoft Excel, Power BI, Python (Pandas), Data Cleaning & Wrangling, Data Visualisation, Descriptive Statistics, Dashboard Design, Business Reporting, Problem Solving — the exact toolkit that separates a hireable fresher from a CV full of coursework. No prior work experience is required. Curiosity, problem-solving ability and a willingness to learn matter far more here than a polished résumé, and every one of these skills is taught on the job.

Who should apply
Students in their final year or recent graduates from B.E./B.Tech, B.Sc/M.Sc (Statistics / Mathematics / Data Science), BCA/MCA, B.Com or BBA/MBA based in or willing to work from Bhilwara. You should be willing to learn SQL, Microsoft Excel, Power BI and able to communicate clearly in writing. Personal projects, coursework, certifications or open-source contributions strengthen your application, but none of them are mandatory.

Internship details
This is a 2-month internship in Bhilwara, Rajasthan, with a stipend of ₹8,000 per month. You will be given a defined project so that you leave with ownership of a recurring report and an analysis a manager acted on. Working hours follow the team's normal business hours and the internship includes a certificate on successful completion.

By the end of the internship you will have hands-on command of the tools and workflows used in the field, plus the confidence that comes from solving genuine problems rather than textbook ones. Interns who excel are regularly offered a PPO and a path into a full-time position.

Eligibility criteria
• Education: B.E./B.Tech, B.Sc/M.Sc (Statistics / Mathematics / Data Science), BCA/MCA, B.Com or BBA/MBA
• Graduating batch: 2026, 2027 or 2028 — final-year students and recent graduates are both eligible
• Academics: 60% / 6.0 CGPA and above preferred; consistent academics help, but a strong project or portfolio is weighed alongside marks
• Technical skills: SQL, Microsoft Excel, Power BI, Python (Pandas), Data Cleaning & Wrangling
• Also useful: Data Visualisation, Descriptive Statistics, Dashboard Design, Business Reporting, Problem Solving
• Soft skills: clear written and spoken English, ownership of your work, comfort asking questions, and the discipline to check your own work before you ship it
• Experience: none required — this is a fresher internship. Academic projects, certifications, GitHub work or a previous internship strengthen an application but are not mandatory
• Location: based in Bhilwara, Rajasthan or willing to work from there for the internship period

Additional information
• Joining date: immediate / rolling — selected candidates usually start within 2-4 weeks of accepting the offer, and start dates can be adjusted around end-semester exams
• Working hours: Monday to Friday, standard business hours (about 8-9 hours a day) at the office
• Duration: 2 months, with a certificate issued on successful completion
• Documents at joining: college ID or degree certificate, a government photo ID, and a No-Objection Certificate from your college where your programme requires one
• Equipment: a workstation, software licences and all tool access are provided at the office — you do not need to bring your own machine
• Bond: no bond and no service agreement is attached to this internship
• Fees: CareStack and MyInternships.in never charge a candidate any fee at any stage of the application, selection or onboarding process. Report anyone who asks you for money in the name of this internship

How to apply
Click Apply Now. If you are not logged in you will be asked to sign in and register first, after which you will be taken to CareStack's official careers page to complete your application. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis and seats are limited, so apply early. Responsibilities: Work on supporting senior analysts on recurring reports, data validation and first-pass analysis alongside the core team; Apply SQL, Microsoft Excel, Power BI, Python (Pandas) to live, production-facing problems; Document your work clearly for reviewers and stakeholders; Participate in reviews and act on the feedback you receive; Collaborate across engineering, product, design or business as required; Follow the team's quality, testing and documentation standards. Requirements: Pursuing or recently completed B.E./B.Tech, B.Sc/M.Sc (Statistics / Mathematics / Data Science), BCA/MCA, B.Com or BBA/MBA; Graduating batch 2026, 2027 or 2028 — final-year students and recent graduates welcome; 60% / 6.0 CGPA and above preferred; strong project work is considered alongside academics; Working knowledge of SQL, Microsoft Excel, Power BI (or a genuine willingness to learn them); Exposure to Python (Pandas), Data Cleaning & Wrangling, Data Visualisation is an advantage; Clear written and verbal communication in English, and care with detail in your work; No prior work experience required — this is a fresher-friendly internship; Based in Bhilwara, Rajasthan or willing to work from there for the internship period.

The Data Product Analyst focuses on data as a product—helping define data contracts, validate quality, assess downstream impact, and support data product and platform decisions.


The ideal candidate is comfortable working across upstream systems of record, platform services, and downstream consumers, and excels at turning complex data flows into actionable insights and decisions.

Product Discovery & Capability Support


Support product discovery by helping translate business and platform needs into clear data‑centric problem statements.


Contribute to roadmap planning by evaluating value, risk, and complexity across data initiatives.


Help define outcomes and success measures for data platform capabilities (e.g., usability, reliability, adoption, quality).


Advanced Data Analysis & Problem Solving


Perform hands‑on exploratory and diagnostic analysis across distributed data sources and platforms.


Investigate data quality issues, lineage gaps, and semantic inconsistencies that affect downstream consumers.


Conduct impact analysis for schema changes, new feeds, platform migrations, or system decommissions.


Identify systemic issues in data flow, transformation, or consumption and recommend durable solutions.


Data Product Ownership (Supporting / Platform‑Level)


Support Data Product Owners by helping define:


Data contracts, schemas, and semantic definitions


Data quality rules, validation logic, and controls


Usage expectations and downstream dependencies


Maintain traceability between business intent, data products, and technical implementation.


Partner with engineering, architecture, and data platform teams to support scalable, reusable distribution patterns.


Agile Execution & Delivery


Contribute to Jira artifacts (features, stories, acceptance criteria) with strong data and platform context.


Participate in backlog refinement, sprint planning, and demos to ensure work reflects validated platform and consumer needs.


Support prioritization decisions by providing evidence‑based impact and dependency analysis.


Stakeholder Communication & Influence


Act as an analytical partner to Product Managers, Platform Owners, Engineering, and downstream consumer teams.


Communicate complex data flow and platform concepts in clear, decision‑ready narratives.


Help align stakeholders across domains by grounding conversations in data realities and trade‑offs.




What are we looking for?


We’re looking for strong collaborators who deliver exceptional client experiences and thrive in fast-paced, team-oriented environments. Our ideal candidates pursue greatness, act with integrity, and are driven to help our clients succeed. We value those who embrace creativity, continuous improvement, and contribute to a culture where we win together and create and share joy in our work.




Requirements:


4+ years of experience in Product Analytics, Data Analysis, Data Product Ownership, or Platform‑oriented Product roles.


Strong hands‑on experience with SQL (advanced querying, joins, performance awareness)


Experience working with data platforms, distributed data systems, or integration layers.


Experience adopting emerging AI‑enabled capabilities to improve the speed, depth, and effectiveness of data analysis


Experience operating in Agile/Scrum environments with cross‑functional product and engineering teams.


Proven ability to work across ambiguity and translate complex data ecosystems into actionable insights.


Solid understanding of:


Data modeling and semantic consistency


Data quality, lineage, and governance concepts


Pipelines, and event‑driven architectures (conceptual and analytical understanding)




Preferences:


Experience supporting advisor data platforms, or shared enterprise data services.


Background in financial services, wealth management, or other highly regulated data environments.



Core Competencies:


Familiarity with downstream consumer needs (applications, analytics platforms, partners, regulatory consumers).


Experience performing impact analysis for data changes across multiple consuming systems.
